subject.qa_finding_title: Pinned jimple2cpg cannot persist the required complete all-JAR graph

post_publication_reverification.note: Wall-clock elapsed is the only figure that varies between runs (2-3 s); every measured field above reproduced byte for byte.

probe.exit_code_semantics: The probe catches Throwable and prints it, so the process exit code is 0 in every arm; the OutOfMemoryError printed on stdout is the observed outcome, not a non-zero exit.

probe_arms.note: Deliberately small heap, run to test whether a small heap fails earlier for a different reason. It does not: it reaches the same ceiling and fails at the same byte, so the invariance is proven across a sixteen-fold heap range and no genuine heap exhaustion occurred in any arm.

arms_conclusion.bound_is_on: the length of one java byte[] array (Integer.MAX_VALUE - 8 = 2147483639)
arms_conclusion.bound_scales_with: total UTF-8 size of the graph's distinct strings, i.e. the breadth of the input set
arms_conclusion.bound_does_not_scale_with: heap size, memory used, or time spent building the graph
arms_conclusion.addend_note: The '+ 77' addend is fixed by the retained probe source; the frontend's own lanes reported '+ 72' (cpg-frontend.log) and '+ 76' (QA F3). The addend is the next string's UTF-8 length; the bound 2147483639 is identical in all cases.

options.bearing_on_bound: Names one input path only; it is why 191 archives must be staged into a single directory. No bearing on the writer.
Names one output filename. Selects neither a format nor a partitioning.

options.bearing_on_bound: Would avert the failure by removing inputs; prohibited (matrix row 2).

options.bearing_on_bound: Same as --exclude, by pattern; prohibited for the same reason.

options.bearing_on_bound: Affects the build phase, not persistence; the failure is in persistence, after the build.

tool_identity_exercised.jimple2cpg_wrapper_body:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Wrapper: Joern 4.x documents JDK 21 as its tested requirement, but Joern's own
# launchers use whatever `java` is on PATH (17 here). Pin 21 before delegating.
export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME_21:-/opt/blitzy-tools/jdk/jdk-21.0.12.1+1}"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
exec /opt/blitzy-tools/joern-cli/joern-cli/jimple2cpg "$@"
tool_identity_exercised.joern_banner_command: printf '' | joern > joern-banner.out 2> joern-banner.err ; grep -m1 -i version joern-banner.out
tool_identity_exercised.failing_writer_mechanism: The entire deduplicated string pool is UTF-8 encoded string by string into ONE java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream, which is backed by a single contiguous byte[].

cited_frontend_failure.label: CITED, not measured by this pass

occurrences.context: STEP 8 (heading line 205, 'Verbatim, as the frontend printed it:' line 207); frames at lines 210-240
section 'VERBATIM FRONTEND OUTPUT, PART 1 - the complete 191-artifact input set', which opens at line 476 and is described there as 34,322 lines / 6,254,213 bytes

cited_frontend_failure.failure_line_verbatim: java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Required array length 2147483639 + 72 is too large
cited_frontend_failure.stack_frames_note: Frames listed in file order from lines 210-240; the scala.runtime/scala.util plumbing frames at lines 223-226 and 230-234 are elided here and present verbatim in the companion .txt.
cited_frontend_failure.brief_discrepancy_recorded: The dispatch brief characterised this recorded lane as having run at -J-Xmx64g. The log itself states -J-Xmx128g (line 83) and 28,863 s (line 95); the log's own words are what is published. The distinction does not affect the conclusion, since arms A, B and C fail identically at 8g, 64g and 128g.

cited_qa_finding.label: CITED, not measured by this pass
cited_qa_finding.failure_message: OutOfMemoryError: Required array length 2147483639 + 76 is too large
cited_qa_finding.staged_bytes_note: QA's independent inventory measured 434,306,178 bytes where the recorded lane's log states 431,184,822 bytes: two independent inventories of two independently built staging trees, both labelled rather than reconciled.
cited_qa_finding.suggested_fix: Human/AAP change required: pin a Joern/flatgraph writer that chunks/streams the string pool, or revise the single-complete-graph requirement. Do not lower heap, trim inputs, or load the partial file.

permitted_action_matrix.action: Raise the heap further (256 GiB, 512 GiB, any value)
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: 'raising a heap is permitted and reported, lowering one produces a truncated graph whose silence cannot be distinguished from a clean result'
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: Arms A, B and C fail at the same byte across a sixteen-fold heap range; the recorded lane was resident at 113.3 GiB inside a 128 GiB heap when it failed.

permitted_action_matrix.action: Trim the input set (--exclude, --exclude-regex, --depth, or dropping pre-shade, -tests or shims archives)
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: 0.3.2 'No trimming of the graph input set, and no exclusion of any JAR the build produced'; 0.5.1 stage the inventory and 'exclude nothing'; 0.2.1 'The input set is never trimmed in either direction to make a number fit'; 0.9.2 preamble 'These are reported, not repaired.'
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: cpg-frontend.log PART 2 records a narrower witness graph over 38 primary artifacts / 52,584 class entries serialising successfully at 418,777,229 bytes (cited from that log).

permitted_action_matrix.action: Upgrade or substitute Joern / flatgraph for a version whose writer chunks or streams the string pool
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: 0.4.3 'None, in any direction. No dependency is added, updated or removed by this run'; 0.8.1 'Nothing is installed, upgraded, substituted or provisioned.' A missing or inadequate tool is a halt-and-report, never a repair task.
permitted_action_matrix.verdict: EFFECTIVE, PROHIBITED TO AN EXECUTING AGENT
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: Installed writer measured as flatgraph-core 0.1.32, sha256 13c99870907a35115be3af6e9f415e712f42e4f970ad3489624dc30f024c1ab0, on the frontend's own classpath.

permitted_action_matrix.action: Use a frontend option that chunks, streams, or changes the output format
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: Moot: there is no such option to permit or forbid.
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: jimple2cpg --help enumerated first-hand: 12 named options and one positional argument; none chunks or streams the writer, none selects an alternative output format, and --full-resolver and --enable-file-content both enlarge the string pool.

permitted_action_matrix.action: Write the graph in parts (split the input, persist per part, merge) or build in memory and query in-process without persisting
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: 0.1.1 requires the graph persisted; 0.5.1 and 0.6.4 require one graph whose byte size and sha256 are recorded at write time and 'recomputed and compared immediately before every one of those loads', and the runners read it from disk by path. Splitting the input is row 2 under another name.
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: No merge facility exists in the pinned distribution's option surface, and a merged graph would carry the same deduplicated string pool and hit the same bound at write time.

permitted_action_matrix.action: Accept the partial file: link it at the sanctioned path, or import it
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: A truncated graph's silence is indistinguishable from a clean result, which is why a graph whose size or digest differs from the value recorded at write time halts the run at any later load.
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: QA's 695,829,405-byte partial was marked DO-NOT-IMPORT and never loaded; the recorded lane's 691,541,019-byte partial was renamed spark.cpg.PARTIAL-TRUNCATED-DO-NOT-LOAD, never linked at harness/cpg/spark.cpg and loaded by no stage. This pass loaded neither.

permitted_action_matrix.action: Present the inherited, provisioned graph as this run's graph
permitted_action_matrix.aap_basis: Permitted only as a labelled divergence, never as satisfaction: 0.9.4 'every divergence is in the record ... each with both the expected and the observed value.'
permitted_action_matrix.verdict: NOT SATISFACTION; ALREADY REPORTED AS A DIVERGENCE
permitted_action_matrix.evidence: The provisioned graph was written over a different input set by provisioning rather than by this run, so it does not satisfy the create-by-this-run requirement.

human_decision_required.statement: Authorise one of exactly two amendments; there is no third form, and neither is within an executing agent's authority.

options.action: Authorise re-provisioning a Joern/flatgraph whose graph writer chunks or streams the string pool, and rebuild the graph over the unchanged complete input set.
Amend the single-complete-graph-over-every-JAR requirement, for example to accept a partitioned set of per-part graphs, each with its own recorded identity, as compliant input.

prohibitions_observed: no jimple2cpg invocation over any real input set
no importCpg and no code-property graph load
no tool installed, upgraded or substituted
no heap lowered for any production operation
nothing written under harness/artifacts/raw/ or oss-scan-results/
